//: Butchering's recipes/kneading holds recipes for A Culinary Artillery's mixing bowl (its kneading recipes, which A Culinary Artillery reads from every mod's recipes/kneading). Butchering ships them switched off ("enabled": false) and switches them on with patches (patches/compatibility/expandedfoods/kneadingrecipesenabled.json): washing bloody offal when A Culinary Artillery is loaded, the sausages when Expanded Foods is. So this file waits for A Culinary Artillery and reads each recipe's enabled flag: a recipe the game leaves switched off is left out here too.
//alternatives: An ingredient may be one of a short list (rendered fat or 10 lard; a cheddar or a blue cheese slice). A reader can't choose between them, so the first of each list counts.
//costs: The recipes give no time, and A Culinary Artillery declares no energy unit, so there are no extra costs.

methods.name: Kneading in A Culinary Artillery's mixing bowl
methods.description: Butchering's recipes for A Culinary Artillery's mixing bowl: sausages from offal, blood, meat or fish nuggets and fat (with Expanded Foods), and washing bloody offal.
